limits: The finite model spreads each pier reaction over BOTH actual L legs and leaves local yaw unrestrained. The earlier one-point corner is a mesh singularity, not a building detail. Actual 1m L arms and 140mm edge beam must develop the forces, with sufficient bars developed into both arms and actual shear transfer across masonry/RC and any construction joint. Mesh density and crack response are development assumptions, not a guaranteed post-damage stiffness.
meshExtent: Radius corners/overlaps and 400-square wet well included; exact local trimmer steel, laps, fire/screed/ports and cage sequencing not included. Complete floor frame and local L-node forces remain separate.
newMesh: H12/150 top and bottom each direction. Compare at most HALF the net steel resistance in each direction for membrane tension, leaving the original one-face 754 mm²/m available for the one-way bending reference. Recheck combined local bending/edge transfer at each hole, stair and bearing.
role: Candidate first-floor RC200 diaphragm with actual voids. Arithmetic N/mm = kN/m; no site/cage selection.

stiffness.source: E_s=200 GPa and two H12/150 layers per direction gives a 1508 MPa axial stiffness comparator. 1200/440 MPa is an authored cracked membrane, not a tested shear law. Actual continuity and concrete diagonal compression must exist. No stiffness from glazing, floor finish, roof deck or disappearing wall.
